propositions: Compiled state must track plan_review_phase (planning or execution) based on winning process_status target, set to execution for in_progress, planning for open, preserving all other values.
Manifest must emit review-phase and execution-only priority-floor tokens in fixed order with strict validation, and legacy attestations without phase must parse as planning.

Phase compatibility enforces planning+planning/legacy=compatible, planning+execution=incompatible, execution+planning/legacy=compatible, execution+execution floor≥0.80=compatible, and malformed phase/floor syntax must be rejected.
Pass-3 threshold must be floored to 0.80 only when execution_review=true and blocking is enabled; planning reviews and advisory-only criteria retain original thresholds.

Plan review signing must capture one immutable generation before LLM/probe, retry collection at most three times only on tracker HEAD instability, and refuse to write any ticket state or signature if collection/sign fails.
